name: Detalle de Iris
description: Analiza los detalles del iris para detectar inconsistencias de deepfake
algorithm: Iris Detail — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes iris detail and rendering quality for deepfake detection:

1. **Iris Región Extracción**: The iris is precisely segmented per frame using circular/elliptical fitting between pupil and limbus (iris-sclera boundary). The iris texture region is extracted and geometrically normalized to a canonical representation (polar coordinates, normalized radius).

2. **Iris Textura Análisis**: Natural iris texture contains complex radial structures (collarette, crypts, furrows, pigment spots) forming a unique biometric pattern. The method analyzes iris texture complexity, radial structure presence, and fine detail quality. AI-generated irises often lack the intricate natural iris texture, appearing either too smooth, too regular, or showing physically implausible patterns.

3. **Bilateral Iris Comparación**: Both irises of the same person should show similar (but not identical) structural characteristics — same color, similar complexity, matching pigmentation patterns. The method compares iris features between eyes. Deepfakes may produce irises with inconsistent appearance (different colors, different detail levels) between left and right eyes.

4. **Iris - Pupila Dynamics**: The pupil-to-iris ratio should respond to light conditions. The method checks whether pupil size is consistent between both eyes and appropriate for the scene illumination. Deepfakes may produce asymmetric pupils or pupil sizes inconsistent with the lighting environment.

5. **Temporal Iris Estabilidad**: Iris texture is a physical structure that doesn't change between frames — only viewing angle and pupil dilation change. The method tracks iris texture consistency (using iris code distance metrics) across frames. Frame-to-frame iris texture changes indicate AI generation where iris detail is independently rendered per frame.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante iris detail analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
